tools.name: digest
tools.description: Summarize a local .docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf/.csv/.md/.txt/.html file into compact facts (structure, headings/slides/pages, columns, sample rows, ~1 KB) without sending the file content.

sampleRows.description: Rows to sample for CSV/XLSX, or slides for PPTX (1-20, default 5).

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Read a bounded window of a local file on demand: text slice for docx/pdf/md/txt/html, row window for csv/xlsx, slide window for pptx. Use only after digest when the user needs actual content.

startRow.description: First row for csv/xlsx, or first slide index 0-based for pptx (default 0).

maxRows.description: Max rows/slides to return (1-200 rows, 1-50 slides, default 20/6).

sheet.description: Sheet name for xlsx (default first sheet).
